Guardrails I keep: Evals against hand-written truth, Schema-validated output, The model reads, the code decides, I review every merge." src="assets/ai-engineering.svg" width="100%">

**Building and testing software that people already use every day.**

I started programming well before the syllabus got there: while class was on the theory, I had already broken and fixed the practical at home. So I read the actual documentation, try things, and take nothing as good until I’ve seen it run.

Today I’m in my second year of DAW while working in three places: full-stack at mesoestetic®, the internal app at ESYPA CASA, and QA at PROVEN.

The model writes roughly 90% of the keystrokes. The other 10% is the job: scoping the problem, deciding what’s worth shipping, debugging what the model got wrong, and understanding every line that ends up in main.

<sub>based in **Barcelona, Spain** · speaks **Català · Español · English** · works **Remote · hybrid in BCN**</sub>

**What I can do for you**

- **A fast site that’s ready to sell** — As fast as this very site, findable on Google, and with a form whose messages actually arrive where they should.
- **Automate repetitive tasks with AI** — That manual process you run every week, turned into something that runs on its own and tells you when something doesn’t add up.
- **Testing that prevents production surprises** — Every release goes through the scenarios your customers really use before it reaches them.
